<p align="center"><strong>Open the chest. Choose its correct symbol.</strong></p>


<p align="center">Three symbols mark an oak chest: moon, pumpkin, spider. A childish hand has scratched October 31 into the desk beside it, over and over.</p>

<p align="center">A note reads: &quot;No wings to fly. No flame to light. Eight legs keep the brass key tight.&quot; Beneath it, in another hand: &quot;She can borrow your voice. She cannot undo my locks. - E.&quot;</p>
